label: Sun 8 Nov 2026
headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 13 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, TPi, TV Technology and 8 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: Acon Digital release Restoration Suite 3
items.take: Acon Digital’s all-in-one restoration plug-in now boasts an Analyze button that allows it to automatically identify issues and present users with a set of modules and settings tailored to their source material.

items.title: Vienna Performer Renders MIDI With Real Players For €9.99 A Month
items.take: Vienna Symphonic Library has released Vienna Performer, a subscription plugin that renders your MIDI as a performed take using players recorded at Synchron Stage. Here are the details.

items.title: The Magnitude Fallacy: Why Some Things Matter – But Maybe Not As Much As We Think
items.take: The fact that a certain phenomenon or scientific principle exists – in pro audio and otherwise – does not necessarily mean it's likely to be a cause of concern in a practical situation. (An audio version of this article is also available for download.)

items.title: tinyant releases purpl, a FREE chorus and shimmer reverb plugin
items.take: tinyant has released purpl, a free chorus and reverb plugin for Windows and Linux. It felt super refreshing to discover a free plugin from a developer I haven’t heard of before, and to find a website without the AI design and bombastic marketing messages we’re seeing everywhere nowadays.

items.title: ZL Limiter, ClassicQlite, simpleTapeStop: Free Plugins of the Week
items.take: ZL Limiter is a free limiter from the creator of ZL Equalizer, ClassicQlite is a British-style EQ, and simpleTapeStop does just what it says.

items.title: Pink Bows Foundation honours Madison Dubiski’s legacy
items.take: Five years ago, 10 young people lost their lives at the Travis Scott Astroworld Festival tragedy in Houston, including 23-year-old Madison Dubiski, who attended the event with her younger brother, Ty. Madison never returned home.

items.title: Democratic Senator Sends Warning to FCC Chairman Carr

items.title: Krotos offers Simple Monsters and 10.5 GB Starter Library FREE until November 11

craft.body: This year Atmos, MPEG-H and binaural delivery moved into ordinary DAWs. The tools will keep changing; the formats last longer. Spend a day with the actual delivery specs you are likely to meet (bed and object counts, loudness targets, binaural render modes) so that when a client asks for immersive delivery, the conversation is about creative choices rather than technical surprises.
craft.title: Learn the formats, not just the tools
